chip.description: Video control unit of the Taito B system: two 16x16 background tilemaps, an 8x8 text tilemap, the sprite engine, a page-flipped framebuffer and the blanking-derived INT/INTL interrupt outputs, all on one die (taxonomy V1).
chip.notes: src/mame/taito/tc0180vcu.cpp in MAME 0.288: three tilemaps created in device_start, a spriteram region at 0x10000, a framebuffer window at 0x40000-0x7ffff, and a vblank callback driving "the INT ... and INTL/\"INT4\" (pin 66) interrupt outputs". Filed video-ppu because one die produces tile layers, sprites and the video-derived timing; this is a judgement call on V1's third limb, since the source documents interrupt outputs rather than sync generation.
